data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'akhtar', meaning noble or exalted. In Islamic tradition, this name symbolizes the high status and nobility of believers in the sight of Allah. The name Akhtari carries the meaning “Noble, Exalted” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Akhtari usually hope their child will grow to embody noble, exalted and live with faith, good character and purpose.
